newsitem.title: USA: Envirodyne sells group to Ivex unit.
newsitem.headline: Envirodyne sells group to Ivex unit.

text.p: Envirodyne Industries Inc said it sold its oriented polystyrene extrusion and thermoforming business based in Sedgefield, England to Kama Europe Ltd, a subsidiary of Ivex Packaging Corp.
In a release dated January 17, Envirodyne said it sold the business for cash plus the assumption of certain liabilities. Specific terms were not disclosed.
The company said its European polyvinyl chloride and oriented polypropylene film businesses, also based in Sedgefield, were not included in the sale.
Envirodyne said the deal allows the company to continue to focus its resources on its core business.
Envirodyne operates food packaging and foodservice supply subsidiaries.
Ivex Packaging is based in Lincolnshire, Illinois.
